shots.text: The Ember Reach was the forge of the world. Its people sang to their fires, and the fires sang back.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Black basalt terraces, lava rivers, glassworks glowing, red and brass banners. Emberfolk at anvils.

shots.text: Then the sea came up the mountain.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: A black tide of seawater and grey-eyed water spirits climbing the slopes, steam rising where it touches lava. Inside the tide, a tall column of water walks: the Saltmother, glimpsed.

shots.text:
Fennick says fire burns and water slows. Fennick says a great many things.

Burn them anyway.
shots.speaker: tamsin
shots.art_note: Tamsin Reed at the ash road, lantern-pole raised, Kethra's forges behind her. Carts moving west.
